analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'wait and see' stance for 3 consecutive days. RSI is moving out of oversold territory (48.2), but MACD histogram improvement has stalled (-0.3027), indicating weak trend reversal signals. While the 5-day low ($152.13) is holding, the price is below the 20-day high ($158.04) and has not broken the upper resistance ($156.42). Low volume (0.25x) further hinders directional confirmation.
